newsitem.title: USA: U.S. BARGE RATES - THINLY QUOTED IN NEARBYS.
newsitem.headline: U.S. BARGE RATES - THINLY QUOTED IN NEARBYS.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were thinly quoted on Wednesday for the nearby positions and no trend was established on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
No barges traded versus none on Tuesday.
- One barge, Ottawa, Illinois River, next week, no bid, offer 115 percent, no comparison.
- One barge, Jeffersonville, Ohio River, next week, no bid, offer 120 percent, no comparison.
- Two barges, St Paul-Savage, Upper Mississippi River, next week, bid 165 percent of tariff, up five percentage points from Tuesday, no offer.
- Two barges, Mid-Mississippi River, next week, bid 130 percent, unchanged from Tuesday, offer 140 percent, unchanged from Tuesday.
- Two barges, Illinois River, next week, no bid, offer 115 percent, down five percentage points from Monday.
